description: Complete GGML two-step accumulator with an invariant duplicated batch
hypothesis: Completing GGML opt_period=2 with two identical copies of the same logical four-state batch exposes an accumulator equal to the LibNC mean gradient within 2e-6 while preserving the frozen first-update, determinism, source closure, dependency, and memory gates.

interfaces_exposed: Frozen LibNC four-state head fixture -> open GGML head backward -> counted clipped Adam update
retired_neighborhoods: Does not retry full PyTorch LibNC autograd parity or port deep attention/FFN gradients; tests only the already near-exact output head.
